# PDF dependencies

- jsPDF **4.2.1**, MIT. Official release: https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF/releases/tag/v4.2.1 . Browser UMD distribution retained locally.
- DejaVu Sans **2.37**, regular and bold, embedded unchanged in `study-fonts.js` to support French accents, Greek letters and mathematical symbols. Official archive: https://github.com/dejavu-fonts/dejavu-fonts/releases/tag/version_2_37 . See `DejaVu-LICENSE.txt`.

No PDF content is sent to a server. No runtime CDN or external font request is used.
